thesis: Grace expresses an intelligent relation between means, constraints and situation; effortless appearance may hide practice or collective preparation.

ideas.statement: Expertise can enrich perception of risks and coordination, but graceful capacity can serve cruelty as readily as care.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Dancer imaging is not a direct beauty measure; visible effort has distinct value and expert technical attention may miss expression.
